title: AP Language Argument Essay (6 points)
description: Scoring guide modeled on the AP English Language and Composition argument essay rubric.

criteria.name: Thesis
criteria.description: Responds to the prompt with a defensible thesis that presents a position.

levels.label: 1 point
levels.description: A defensible thesis that responds to the prompt.

levels.label: 0 points
levels.description: No defensible thesis, or it only restates the prompt or summarizes.

criteria.name: Evidence & Commentary
criteria.description: Specific evidence supports a line of reasoning, and commentary explains how.

levels.label: 4 points
levels.description: Specific evidence for all claims in a line of reasoning; consistently explains how it supports the argument.

levels.label: 3 points
levels.description: Specific evidence for all claims; explains how some of it supports the line of reasoning.

levels.label: 2 points
levels.description: Some specific evidence; explains some of it, but the line of reasoning is missing or faulty.

levels.label: 1 point
levels.description: Mostly general evidence; summarizes rather than explains.

levels.label: 0 points
levels.description: Restates the thesis, or offers irrelevant or no evidence.

criteria.name: Sophistication
criteria.description: Demonstrates sophistication of thought or a complex understanding of the rhetorical situation.

levels.label: 1 point
levels.description: Nuanced argument, situates it in a broader context, or a vivid, persuasive style throughout.

levels.label: 0 points
levels.description: Does not meet the criteria for one point.
